Are you using any security app, VPN or firewall that could be blocking the connection. If so, please try after disabling them.

The issue is on the network communication side rather than authentication. See if the issue also exhibits on both wifi and cellular network.

Having you tested since you posted to rule out a temporary server issue on talktalk's end?

TalkTalks own status page indicates they're aware of email issues https://help-centre.talktalk.co.uk/Service_Status#

We're aware that some customers are currently experiencing issues with their Email services. We'd like to apologise for any inconvenince caused during this time and assure you that our engineers are working to restore the service as a priority.
